newsitem.title: USA: Sprint soars on MCI /BT news.
newsitem.headline: Sprint soars on MCI /BT news.

text.p: Shares of Sprint Corp surged 12 percent late Friday after news emerged that rival MCI Communications was in talks to merge with British Telecommunications Plc.
Sprint Corp shares rose 4-3/4 to 44 on the New York Stock Exchange in late trading.
Thom Brown, managing director of Rutherford Brown and Catherwood said the deal "ought to help stocks like Sprint".

Regional Bells were slightly higher after the deal was announced. Bell Atlantic Corp rose 1/8 to 60-3/8. NYNEX Corp shares added 1/2 to 45. PacTel Corp shares were up 1/8 to 34-1/8. Ameritech climbed 1/8 to 54-7/8.
BellSouth Corp fell 3/8 to 40-3/8, while U S West lost 1/8 to 30-1/4.
SBC Communications Corp shares were flat at 48-5/8.
AT&T Corp shares fell 3/8 to 34-1/2. GTE Corp shares fell 1-1/2 to 40-5/8.
